name: Shiitake mushroom
description: Meaty aromatic mushroom, fresh or dried.

histamine.note: Dried/aged forms carry more amines than fresh.

effects.note: A randomised trial had healthy adults eat 5-10g of whole dried shiitake daily for a month and found real increases in the immune system's own natural killer and γδ-T cell activity, plus a rise in the mucosal antibody sIgA and a drop in the inflammation marker CRP — a genuine food-dose result, though from a single trial measuring immune markers rather than actual illness counts. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
